data.name: ConSent - Stolen Dreams
data.detailed_description:
Discover the truth behind Carpathia's dark past and its potentially much darker future.

The story follows the cumbersome life of a subway logistics specialist, under the pseudonym Mintaka. Dreams of surreal memories haunt him. After being approached and blackmailed by an unknown man - a self-proclaimed Recruiter - he is forced to sabotage the city's subway infrastructure.

What's going on in the Carpathian sub-world? What's in it for the Recruiter? What's beyond the blast doors? Where do Mintaka's dreams of unseen locations and people come from?

Do you consent to finding it out for yourself?

o Immerse yourself in a heavily destructible, detailed world, full of curiosities!
o Collect and upgrade your weapons to fight back waves of drones!
o Be stealthy and use your handheld hacking terminal to cause confusion within the peacemakers' ranks!
o Find collectibles to unlock long lost memories!
o Complete the story to gain access to extra features!
